author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.12.0 — Rooms per run now defaults to 1: a single-room dispatch is always ground truth for that room's clean time, and since rotation always picks the most-overdue room, this builds a real per-room timing corpus through normal use with no separate Learning Mode pass needed. Also adds manual room-time overrides under Room Timing (per-room editable minutes fields + Save Room Times) so timing data can be corrected or restored by hand, e.g. after reinstalling the app resets learned state.
